module Base
{
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Off-Grid items. GENERATED by tools/build_scripts.py -- edit the
     * taxonomy, not this file.
     *
     * All of them are ItemType = base:moveable, which is what the inventory
     * context menu tests for before it offers "Place Object"
     * (ISInventoryPaneContextMenu.lua:212 -> instanceof(item, "Moveable")).
     * The engine then binds the item to its world tile through
     * Moveable.ReadFromWorldSprite, which needs the SPRITE to carry both
     * IsMoveAble and CustomItem -- both set in offgrid_tiles.tiles. Between
     * the two, vanilla handles pick-up and placement and the mod ships no
     * placement code of its own.
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /* The controller is the piece that actually delivers power, and the only
       way to do that in B42 is to be a real IsoGenerator: a square is powered
       iff chunk.isGeneratorPoweringSquare() finds an activated generator in
       range, and IsoGenerator.chunkLoaded() deletes any registered position
       that is not backed by one.

       That map is keyed on one sprite per item, so every sprite the object can
       be DRAWN as needs its own record: four facings times two states, per
       grade. Only the south-facing "off" record is craftable or carryable; the
       other seven per grade exist purely to keep the object resolving to a mod
       item with SoundRadius = 1 rather than to Base.Generator at radius 20. */

    item OffGridControllerE
    {
        DisplayName         = Charge Controller,
        DisplayCategory     = Electronics,
        ItemType            = base:moveable,
        Weight              = 8.0,
        Icon                = OffGridController,
        WorldObjectSprite   = offgrid_01_200,
        ConditionMax        = 100,
        Tags                = base:hasmetal;base:showcondition;base:generator,
        ConditionLowerChanceOneIn = 100000,
        SoundRadius         = 1,
        SoundVolume         = 1,
    }

    item OffGridController
    {

    /* The manuals. Without one, none of the recipes are known, so the gate is
       finding a book rather than grinding a level. */

    item OffGridManual
    {
        DisplayName         = Photovoltaic Systems Handbook,
        DisplayCategory     = RecipeResource,
        ItemType            = base:literature,
        Weight              = 0.5,
        Icon                = OffGridManual,
        BoredomChange       = -18,
        StressChange        = -10,
        LearnedRecipes      = MakeOffGridArraySalvage;MakeOffGridFlatSalvage;MakeOffGridBankCrate;MakeOffGridWallCrate;MakeOffGridArray;MakeOffGridFlat;MakeOffGridBank;MakeOffGridWallBank;MakeOffGridController,
        StaticModel         = Magazine,
        WorldStaticModel    = MagazineElec1Ground,
        Tags                = base:magazine,
        OnCreate            = ItemCodeOnCreate.onCreateRecipeMagazine,
    }

    item OffGridManualAdv
    {
        DisplayName         = Advanced Photovoltaics and MPPT,
        DisplayCategory     = RecipeResource,
        ItemType            = base:literature,
        Weight              = 0.6,
        Icon                = OffGridManualAdv,
        BoredomChange       = -14,
        StressChange        = -8,
        LearnedRecipes      = MakeOffGridArrayMono;MakeOffGridFlatMono;MakeOffGridBankSealed;MakeOffGridWallSealed;MakeOffGridControllerMPPT,
        StaticModel         = Magazine,
        WorldStaticModel    = MagazineElec1Ground,
        Tags                = base:magazine,
        OnCreate            = ItemCodeOnCreate.onCreateRecipeMagazine,
    }

    /* The almanac teaches an ABILITY, not a recipe, and it does it through the
       same LearnedRecipes field. That is not a trick: Item.parseLine splits the
       field on ';' into a plain list with no validation against any registry,
       learnRecipe appends whatever it is handed, and vanilla itself teaches
       Herbalist, Generator and the three Mechanics tiers this way -- none of
       which has a craftRecipe record anywhere in the shipped scripts.
       OG_Almanac registers OffGridSkyReading in ISLiteratureUI.miscRecipes so
       it renders in the knowledge list with an icon like those do.

       A book rather than a magazine, so it looks like one on the floor. */

    item OffGridAlmanac
    {
        DisplayName         = Knox County Almanac,
        DisplayCategory     = RecipeResource,
        ItemType            = base:literature,
        Weight              = 0.4,
        Icon                = OffGridAlmanac,
        BoredomChange       = -20,
        StressChange        = -12,
        LearnedRecipes      = OffGridSkyReading,
        StaticModel         = Book,
        WorldStaticModel    = BookClosedGround,
        Tags                = base:magazine,
        OnCreate            = ItemCodeOnCreate.onCreateRecipeMagazine,
    }
}
